title: The Cold Border
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Ivo Okafor, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
